releases.notes:
## In-game guide

- Open the **UniverseGate Guide** from the pause menu or the Portal Core icon on the Minecraft title screen. On NeoForge, you can also open it from the mod's **Config** button.
- Follow animated, step-by-step 3D scenes built with the mod's own block models. Pause, rotate the view, or move between steps at your own pace.
- Browse the mod's lore, energy systems, portal construction, the Rift, the weather machine, DNA and cloning, and crafting recipes. The Dark Energy and ZPC chapter is marked as a work in progress.
- The **Live Portal View** toggle has moved to the guide's **Settings**.

## Portal visuals

- On Minecraft 1.21.1, the front of the portal has a darker vortex with silvery filaments, and the live destination view stays visible through it. The back shows a separate deep-space effect with twinkling stars and drifting clouds.
- The portal ring has finer crystal details and smoother veins. The event horizon has a smoother inner rim and a paneled inner wall.
- Dark ring surfaces stay black with Iris shader packs such as BSL.

## Compatibility

- Fabric and NeoForge builds are available for Minecraft 1.21.1 and 1.21.11.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/geomtech/Mod-UniverseGate/compare/v1.0.38...v1.0.39)

- Player crossings use the finalized movement and viewing direction. Failed vehicle teleports restore the passenger hierarchy.

**Minecraft:** 1.21.1 and 1.21.11, on Fabric and NeoForge.

releases.notes:
## What's new

### Portal Redstone Activator
- New **Portal Redstone Activator** block for automating gates. Set its destination, wire it to the portal with Electric Wire and Crocodile Clips, then send it a redstone pulse to open the preset destination.
- It opens on the rising edge of the signal and follows the usual portal energy rules.
- Recipe (shapeless): Portal Controller + Redstone Dust + Redstone Repeater. Mine it with an iron pickaxe or better.

### Create train support (NeoForge 1.21.1, Create 6.0.10)
- Portals now keep `create:track` blocks when they open or close.
- **Two portals in the same dimension:** the whole train jumps at once and stops on the destination track.
  - All players on board travel with the train, standing or seated, wherever they are in the carriage.
  - Each player's view turns with their carriage, so they still face the same way relative to the train.
  - The driver keeps the Create controls through the jump, even if the client briefly respawns the carriage. Esc, sneak and the normal distance checks still release the controls.
  - The client is told about the jump right away, so the carriage doesn't trail behind its new position.
  - If the track runs through the source portal and the exit is blocked, the train waits until it clears. Back away to cancel.
- **Portals in different dimensions:** trains use Create's own interdimensional travel, and Create schedules can route through these links. This requires a track that ends at the Portal Core on both sides.
- The Create integration loads only with Create 6.0.10 on NeoForge 1.21.1. Other setups are unaffected and Create remains optional.

## Fixes
- Better Mixin compatibility with Lithium and large modpacks. Portal half-collision now skips entities that are not near a portal, so vanilla and Lithium collision run at full speed for them.
- Fixed client-only code being reached on dedicated servers during portal collision handling.

## Notes
- Lay a straight, level track perpendicular to the frame, directly on top of the Portal Core, and keep the approach and exit long enough for the entire train. See the README for details.
- Create schedules cannot route through links within a single dimension.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geomtech/Mod-UniverseGate/compare/v1.0.32...v1.0.35

releases.notes:
## Seamless Real-Time Portal Engine

- **Live view through active portals**: Look directly into the destination world (including across dimensions) in real time with oblique near-plane frustum clipping, full natural and artificial (block) lighting, live block updates, block entities, and real-time entities.
- **Front-face portal window**: The live world view renders exclusively on the front face of each portal (the controller side), while the rear face preserves the classic dark membrane.
- **Seamless floor threshold**: Buried portals now seamlessly blend their base threshold across both sides with proper lighting and zero floor gap.

## Loading-Screen-Free Cross-Dimension Traversal

- **Zero loading screen**: Crossing between dimensions now preloads destination chunks and skips the `ReceivingLevelScreen` / `LevelLoadingScreen` transition cleanly while preserving authentic vanilla world state, lighting, and block interactions.
- **Bidirectional front-face vortices**: Portals now allow two-way travel (`source <-> destination`) while restricting entry to each portal's front face (controller side).
- **Continuous physics & kinematics**:
  - Natural yaw/pitch continuity, preserved momentum, and accurate transformed trajectories for players, mobs, vehicles, projectiles, and dropped items across dimensions.
  - Reliable high-speed crossing detection with anti-tunneling sweep and proactive cooldown/hysteresis cleanup so sprinting through portals never misses teleportation.
  - Half-through collision suppression for blocks directly behind an active portal opening.

## Compatibility & Stability

- Isolated remote chunk streaming, per-world `SectionBufferBuilderPool`, and strict isolation of remote preview worlds from the active `LevelRenderer`, sounds, and particles.
- Clean fallback to the classic portal membrane when Sodium/Iris pipelines or stencil buffers are unavailable.
- Multi-loader support for **Fabric** and **NeoForge** on Minecraft **1.21.1** and **1.21.11**.

releases.notes:
## Power-loss instability & shockwave blast

- Active portals that run out of energy no longer shut down instantly: they now enter a **45-second power-loss instability** synced across both sides of the link.
- Restoring power before the countdown ends restabilizes the vortex cleanly, and shutting down manually from the portal controller avoids the blast.
- Passing through a portal during a power-loss instability no longer extends its duration and instead shortens the collapse countdown by 5 seconds.
- If the countdown expires without power, the vortex collapses with a **shockwave blast** on the source side that shatters glass blocks and panes within a 9-block radius, pushes nearby entities back, and releases a burst of steam and sparks.

## Unstable gate visuals

- Unstable 3D portals now spin much faster (accelerating further during the final 10 seconds), vent dense clouds of steam and smoke from the ring and base vents, crackle with intense electric arcs, and blink their three crystals in white.

## Wired portal controller & 3D cables

- Crafted **Portal Controllers** now require crocodile clips and electric wires connected to a portal frame or core (natural village controllers remain wireless).
- Electric wires render as smooth 3D octagonal cables with curved bends, rounded risers, dedicated break/place/step sounds, and natural 3D gate lighting.
- Portal opening energy is now verified before starting the opening sequence so failed attempts no longer play opening sounds.

releases.notes:
## Redesigned portals

- Assembled portals now feature a **rotating 3D ring**. The base sits above ground or blends into the terrain, depending on how the portal is built.
- New opening and closing sequences feature a dark pixel-art membrane, glowing cracks, electrical arcs, crackling sounds, and steam vents.
- Portal control consoles have been redesigned. Naturally generated village consoles now face the player's approach.

## Lightning antennas and wiring

- A **freestanding, four-block-tall lightning antenna** replaces the old portal lightning rod. Connect it to a portal with electric wires and crocodile clips. A lightning strike can open an unstable link to the Rift. The antenna stores up to **five charges** when no connected portal can open.
- Red and blue wires run along floors, walls, and ceilings and connect to matching antenna terminals. At the portal, exposed copper leads attach to screws on the fixed base. Elevated wires hang down and rest on the ground before reaching the terminals.
- Portal activation and world reloads preserve cables, clips, and their supports inside the opening. A broken cable run or a clip attached to an isolated frame block cannot trigger a nearby portal.
- Existing **Charged Lightning Rods** can be crafted into the new antenna.

## Minecraft compatibility

- Added **Minecraft 1.21.11** support alongside **1.21.1**, for both **Fabric** and **NeoForge**.
- Fixed Rift terrain generation on Minecraft 1.21.11.

- Energy compatibility with other mods: UniverseGate EU now works with the standard energy APIs (FE on NeoForge, Team Reborn Energy on Fabric), so Stellaris, Mekanism, Powah, Tech Reborn and others can connect. None of these mods is required.
  - Energy Condensers and Energy Conduits accept and supply energy; the ZPC Interface only supplies.
  - 1 EU = 1 FE, up to 1000 per tick per connected block.
  - Dark Energy keeps its own network.
- Portal opening particles are now generated client-side.

Note: server and clients must run the same version.

# Changelog

### Added
- Added a full DNA extraction workflow with the new DNA Extractor item, including a timed extraction process, target validation, and crystal cost requirements.
- Added DNA sample items that store entity identity, optional custom name, and rechargeable usage tracking.
- Added Mob Cloner and Mob Cloner Controller machines, including menus/screens, crafting recipes, loot tables, textures, blockstates, and item/block models.
- Added a Dark Energy Generator UI (menu + screen) with live fuel/buffer/network status.
- Added a HUD overlay that displays real-time DNA extraction progress while aiming at a valid target.
- Added a portal pursuit tracker so nearby mobs pursuing a player can continue pursuit through portal transitions.

### Changed
- Upgraded energy monitor synchronization and UI to 64-bit values to avoid overflow on large networks.
- Updated energy network aggregation to count both condensers and ZPC reservoirs in shared capacity snapshots.
- Extended standard and dark-energy conduit connectivity to support mob cloning machines.
- Updated item models for fluid pipes and dark-energy conduits to use dedicated inventory display models.
- Updated the mobile portal controller item model/texture mapping.
- Expanded English/French localization with new GUI labels, messages, and tooltips for cloning and dark-energy workflows.

### Fixed
- Fixed portal traversal stability by forcing outbound chunk loading during active/open states and for a grace period after player passage.
- Fixed one-way/blocked traversal edge cases so destination contact can keep linked portal state synchronized.
- Fixed pursuit continuity by restoring mob target behavior after teleport and preventing tracked mobs from natural despawn during pursuit windows.
- Restricted DNA anvil enchant behavior to allow only Unbreaking-compatible outcomes.

## New Features

### ZPC Power System
- Added **ZPC (Zero Point Condensate)** - an ultra-high-capacity energy module (40 billion EU)
- Added **ZPC Interface Controller** block - accepts up to 3 ZPCs and feeds power into connected energy conduits
- ZPCs integrate into the energy network alongside condensers, solar panels, and parabolas
- New GUI showing charge percentage, modules installed, energy output, and network status
- ZPCs can be ejected with sneak + right-click

### Mobile Portal Controller
- Added **Portal Mobile Keyboard** - a handheld item that can dial nearby portals
- Works within 8 blocks of a portal core
- Opens the familiar portal dialing interface on use

### Loot & World Generation
- ZPCs can now be found in Minecraft chests worldwide (0.35% chance)
- **Guaranteed ZPC** in Ancient City chests when first opened
- ZPCs can also drop from Rift Cube generators

## Improvements

### Network Improvements
- Improved controller access resolution for portal networks (supports natural, fixed, and mobile keyboards)
- Better conduit scanning and energy source prioritization

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed portal teleportation to preserve Ender Pearl momentum
- Fixed natural keyboard detection in portal vicinity
- Fixed portal axis resolution in connection handling
- Fixed server tick timing in portal core
- Fixed Kelo Log loot table (now always drops)
- Fixed Rift Refiner recipe (now uses iron ingots instead of white purpur)

## Translations
- Added English and French translations for all new content

- Better dark-dimension routing/target resolution during dialing.

- Updated block tool requirements and mineable tags for new machine blocks.

- Updated multiple machine and item textures (energy, fluid, and related assets).
